geometry.method: External passive Page.close preload, after each unchanged checker cell has computed/pushed its result. No new page visits, no changed checker/timers/conditions. readStateSweeps.method: All seven role/state fixtures, every named state where its exact response contract supports it; browser-only interception, fresh context for denied cases. 360/430 and125/150 remain full automated/geometry cells, plus expand a state immediately where a measured defect depends on them. Unsupported model states require source/contract rationale, not a silently passed case.
readStateSweeps.engineScope: Chromium at320/390/landscape; WebKit390spots plus all earlier engine-specific reproduction cells and independent exact-candidate proofs. No automatic all-engine manual-state crossproduct.
